row.title: The boundary kernel of a compact oriented 3-manifold is Lagrangian
proof_obligations: For a compact oriented 3-manifold M with closed boundary Σ, prove ker(H1(Σ;R)→H1(M;R)) is isotropic and equals its symplectic orthogonal, including disconnected boundaries. Derive the kernel formula from the exact sequence, cap naturality, and Poincare–Lefschetz duality; state the full AC use inherited from duality.

row.title: The boundary kernel of a compact oriented 3-manifold is Lagrangian
proof_obligations: For any compact oriented smooth 3-manifold M with possibly disconnected closed boundary Σ, prove ker(H1(Σ;R)→H1(M;R)) is isotropic and equals its intersection-form orthogonal. Derive it using the homology pair sequence, Poincare–Lefschetz cap duality, and the cap boundary identity; state full AC inherited from duality.
